title: David Bailey back at practice after ankle injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: David Bailey back at practice after ankle injury
sources.description: Jets first-round pick David Bailey hurt his ankle at practice last weekend, but head coach Aaron Glenn said the linebacker's injury was minor and that was proven correct on Tuesday.
